scripts.title: Leaderstats (Coins)
scripts.desc: Creates the leaderboard with a Coins value for every player.
scripts.descAr: ينشئ لوحة الترتيب مع قيمة Coins لكل لاعب.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	local stats = Instance.new("Folder")
	stats.Name = "leaderstats"
	stats.Parent = player

	local coins = Instance.new("IntValue")
	coins.Name = "Coins"
	coins.Value = 0
	coins.Parent = stats
end)

scripts.title: Save Coins (DataStore)
scripts.desc: Loads and saves the Coins value safely with pcall. Enable API access in Studio to test.
scripts.descAr: يحمّل ويحفظ قيمة Coins بأمان باستخدام pcall. فعّل Studio API Access للتجربة.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerCoins_v1")

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	local stats = Instance.new("Folder")
	stats.Name = "leaderstats"
	stats.Parent = player

	local coins = Instance.new("IntValue")
	coins.Name = "Coins"
	coins.Parent = stats

	local ok, saved = pcall(function()
		return store:GetAsync(tostring(player.UserId))
	end)
	coins.Value = (ok and saved) or 0
end)

local function save(player)
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local coins = stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if not coins then return end
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		store:SetAsync(tostring(player.UserId), coins.Value)
	end)
	if not ok then
		warn("Save failed: " .. tostring(err))
	end
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(save)

game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		save(player)
	end
end)

scripts.title: Coin Pickup
scripts.desc: Touch a coin part to earn coins; it respawns after 5 seconds.
scripts.descAr: المس قطعة العملة لتكسب عملات وتعود بعد 5 ثوانٍ.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local coin = script.Parent
local VALUE = 1
local collected = false

coin.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	if collected then return end
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
	if not player then return end
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local coins = stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if coins then
		collected = true
		coins.Value += VALUE
		coin.Transparency = 1
		coin.CanCollide = false
		task.wait(5)
		coin.Transparency = 0
		collected = false
	end
end)

scripts.title: Click To Earn
scripts.desc: A ClickDetector part that gives +1 coin per click.
scripts.descAr: قطعة بها ClickDetector تعطي عملة عند كل نقرة.
scripts.code:
local clickDetector = script.Parent:WaitForChild("ClickDetector")

clickDetector.MouseClick:Connect(function(player)
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local coins = stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if coins then
		coins.Value += 1
	end
end)

scripts.title: Kill Brick
scripts.desc: Resets the player's health to 0 when they touch the part.
scripts.descAr: يصفّر صحة اللاعب عند لمس القطعة.
scripts.code:
local part = script.Parent

part.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local humanoid = hit.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid then
		humanoid.Health = 0
	end
end)

scripts.title: Checkpoint
scripts.desc: Touch a SpawnLocation to respawn there next time.
scripts.descAr: المس SpawnLocation لتظهر عنده في المرة القادمة.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local spawnPoint = script.Parent

spawnPoint.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
	if player then
		player.RespawnLocation = spawnPoint
	end
end)

scripts.title: Jump Pad
scripts.desc: Launches the player upward. Change POWER to adjust the height.
scripts.descAr: يقذف اللاعب للأعلى. غيّر POWER لتعديل الارتفاع.
scripts.code:
local pad = script.Parent
local POWER = 90
local debounce = {}

pad.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local character = hit.Parent
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if humanoid and root and not debounce[character] then
		debounce[character] = true
		local v = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(v.X, POWER, v.Z)
		task.wait(0.5)
		debounce[character] = nil
	end
end)

scripts.title: Teleport Pad
scripts.desc: Teleports the player to a part named TeleportDestination.
scripts.descAr: ينقل اللاعب إلى قطعة اسمها TeleportDestination.
scripts.code:
local pad = script.Parent
local destination = workspace:WaitForChild("TeleportDestination")
local debounce = {}

pad.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local character = hit.Parent
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if root and not debounce[character] then
		debounce[character] = true
		root.CFrame = destination.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
		task.wait(1)
		debounce[character] = nil
	end
end)

scripts.title: Rainbow Spinning Part
scripts.desc: A decorative anchored part that spins and cycles colors.
scripts.descAr: قطعة زخرفية ثابتة تدور وتغيّر ألوانها.
scripts.code:
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local part = script.Parent

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	part.CFrame = part.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(60) * dt, 0)
	part.Color = Color3.fromHSV((tick() % 5) / 5, 1, 1)
end)

scripts.title: Day / Night Cycle
scripts.desc: Advances the in-game clock so a full day lasts DAY_LENGTH seconds.
scripts.descAr: يحرّك ساعة اللعبة ليستغرق اليوم الكامل DAY_LENGTH ثانية.
scripts.code:
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local DAY_LENGTH = 300 -- seconds for a full day

while true do
	Lighting.ClockTime = (Lighting.ClockTime + 24 / DAY_LENGTH) % 24
	task.wait(1)
end

scripts.title: Sprint (Hold Shift)
scripts.desc: Hold Left Shift to run faster. Client-side input for your own game.
scripts.descAr: اضغط Shift مطولاً للركض أسرع. إدخال من جهة اللاعب في لعبتك.
scripts.code:
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local WALK, RUN = 16, 28

local function setSpeed(speed)
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid then
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = speed
	end
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	if processed then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift then
		setSpeed(RUN)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift then
		setSpeed(WALK)
	end
end)

scripts.title: Item Dropper
scripts.desc: Drops a yellow brick every 2 seconds that carries a Value attribute.
scripts.descAr: يُسقط قطعة صفراء كل ثانيتين تحمل خاصية Value.
scripts.code:
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local dropper = script.Parent
local INTERVAL = 2
local VALUE = 5

while true do
	local drop = Instance.new("Part")
	drop.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
	drop.Position = dropper.Position - Vector3.new(0, dropper.Size.Y / 2 + 1, 0)
	drop.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright yellow")
	drop:SetAttribute("Value", VALUE)
	drop.Parent = workspace
	Debris:AddItem(drop, 20)
	task.wait(INTERVAL)
end
